stories.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
stories.summary: Reflection has introduced Beam, an open-weight AI model pitched as a lower-compute-cost rival to Chinese models. The company is targeting enterprises and sovereign nations with “AI factories” that would let institutions train customised local systems on proprietary data.

links.headline: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
links.excerpt: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.

stories.title: How American political campaigns are using AI – and what they’re spending on the tools
stories.summary: New U.S. campaign-finance disclosure data shows which political candidates, parties and committees are paying for AI tools and how much they are spending.
